title: Insiders behind the $TRUMP and $MELANIA launches (Hayden Davis, Meteora, Kelsier)
summary: The claim accurately describes the allegations. A Burwick Law class action accused Meteora's Benjamin Chow and Kelsier's Hayden Davis of running MELANIA, LIBRA and other tokens as a pump-and-dump, calling Melania Trump and Milei 'props' and alleging about $10M in MELANIA insider gains. Davis admitted he was the launch strategist for both tokens and that his team sniped them. Neither court found fraud: SDNY Judge Rochon dismissed the suit with prejudice on 2026-09-29 and refused to add MELANIA, and Argentina dropped its LIBRA criminal case in October 2026. No US regulator has acted. $TRUMP was operated by Fight Fight Fight LLC (Bill Zanker) and CIC Digital on Meteora, earning an estimated $350M+ in sales and fees; no source shows Davis ran it.

sub_claims.statement: A class action alleged Chow/Meteora and Davis/Kelsier ran MELANIA and LIBRA as a pump-and-dump, using Melania Trump and Milei as 'props'.
sub_claims.finding: Hurlock v. Kelsier (SDNY 1:25-cv-03891-JLR) was filed by Burwick Law in March 2025 over LIBRA. The proposed second amended complaint (2025-10-21) named Chow, Meteora, Kelsier, and Hayden, Gideon and Charles Davis. It alleged a scheme across at least 15 tokens, focusing on LIBRA, MELANIA, ENRON, TRUST and M3M3, and called the celebrities 'props'. Melania Trump was not a defendant and is not accused of wrongdoing.

Coverage of the complaint says plaintiffs allege that insider wallets tied to Chow and Davis took about $10M from MELANIA. Bubblemaps separately reported about $30M of 'community' tokens moved and sold (Apr 2025) and an earlier about $2M single-sided liquidity extraction tied to Davis. EmberCN reported about $14.75M sold in one month. All are untested allegations and estimates. Davis said the MELANIA team 'made no money'.

sub_claims.statement: Hayden Davis/Kelsier ran the MELANIA and LIBRA launches.
sub_claims.finding: Davis told Coffeezilla (Feb 2025) that he was launch strategist for LIBRA and MELANIA and that his team sniped both. Bubblemaps' wallet clustering ties the two launches together. Chow resigned as Meteora CEO on 2025-02-18; Meow (Jupiter) said Fenwick & West would investigate, but no published findings were located. The issuer of record for MELANIA remains MKT World LLC.

sub_claims.statement: $TRUMP was operated by Bill Zanker's Fight Fight Fight LLC and CIC Digital, not by Davis/Kelsier.
sub_claims.finding: Fight Fight Fight LLC (run by Zanker and owned by Celebration Cards LLC) and CIC Digital LLC (a Trump Organization affiliate) hold 80% of supply. The token launched on Meteora, and its creators take a share of trading fees. Chow said the team dealt with co-founder Meow. TRUMP-team wallets received about $4.2M in Meteora's MET airdrop (Oct 2025). No source shows Davis operating $TRUMP; a second-hand report of him describing a pre-launch Trump-associated sale is unverified.

sub_claims.statement: Early wallets made large sniping profits.
sub_claims.finding: MELANIA: the FT reported 24 wallets spent about $2.6M roughly 2.5 minutes before the announcement and made nearly $100M; Lookonchain reported 3 wallets bought more than 420M tokens pre-listing. A claimed Arkham link from one wallet to a Barron Trump address is unverified. TRUMP: 58 wallets made more than $10M each (Chainalysis, see C01), and individual snipers made up to about $100M+. No credible evidence shows the operators sniped their own launch. Aggregator figures of $1.2B-$4B in 'insider' gains are unverified.

sub_claims.statement: The $TRUMP operators earned large trading-fee revenue.
sub_claims.finding: Fee estimates for 2025-01-17 to 01-30 are about $86M-$100M (Merkle Science, Chainalysis). The FT put the total at at least $350M by March 2025 ($314M in token sales plus $36M in fees). CoinDesk/Chainalysis put fees at about $320M by May 2025, with about 5% to Meteora. TRUMP-team wallets withdrew about $94M USDC from Meteora pools in December 2025. Trump's OGE-reported $635M in royalties (C01) is a different measure.

Rochon unfroze about $57.6M USDC on 2025-08-19. On 2026-09-29 she dismissed the LIBRA/M3M3 class action with prejudice: RICO failed for no adequate pattern, state claims failed for lack of personal jurisdiction over Kelsier, and the claims against Chow and Meteora were deficient. Adding MELANIA was denied as futile. There was no merits finding on fraud, and no appeal was reported as of early October 2026. In Argentina, Judge Martínez de Giorgi dismissed the LIBRA criminal case against Milei, Karina Milei, Davis and others in October 2026; the opposition is contesting it.

No SEC, DOJ or CFTC action against Davis, Kelsier, Chow, Meteora or Fight Fight Fight was found. SEC staff said in February 2025 that meme coins are generally not securities. Democratic senators sent letters: Blumenthal to Fight Fight Fight (2025-05-06), Warren/Schiff/Blumenthal to Zanker (2026-04-08), and Warren/Blumenthal asking SEC Chair Atkins to investigate (2026-08). Reports of a DOJ LIBRA probe are unconfirmed. An Argentine congressional commission (Nov 2025) found Milei may have breached ethics law.

corrections: MELANIA was only in a proposed amended complaint; the court never admitted it and later denied the amendment as futile.
The '$10M+' insider figure is the complaint's. Bubblemaps' estimate of team sales is about $30M, and FT-reported sniper profits (about $100M) are a separate category.
The litigation has not established wrongdoing. The SDNY case was dismissed with prejudice on 2026-09-29 and Argentina's criminal case was dismissed in October 2026.
No source shows Davis/Kelsier operated $TRUMP. Its issuers are Fight Fight Fight LLC and CIC Digital.
denials_and_context: Davis denies wrongdoing, calls LIBRA 'a plan gone miserably wrong' and says sniping 'is not illegal' in meme markets.
Chow denies leaking information or receiving tokens; Meow said there was 'no financial impropriety'.
Fight Fight Fight has not publicly answered the senators' letters; no White House or Melania Trump comment on the suit was found.
Judge Rochon's dismissal rests on pleading, RICO-pattern and jurisdiction grounds and expressly makes no finding on whether manipulation occurred.
The original pages at protos.com, solanacompass.com, decrypt.co and coindesk.com were not read directly; their content is cited from search summaries across multiple outlets.

leads.why_connected: This shows ongoing cash extraction by the $TRUMP operators via single-sided liquidity, the same technique Davis is accused of using on MELANIA and LIBRA.

leads.why_connected: These are direct payments from the DEX whose co-founder was sued to the Trump-family token teams, arriving hours after the amended complaint was filed.

leads.title: Fight Fight Fight seeks $200M-$1B for a TRUMP digital-asset treasury
leads.why_connected: This would be a new vehicle to buy up the collapsing token, run by the same operator (Zanker) that shares revenue with CIC Digital.

changes: No changes. The dismissal date, the with-prejudice ruling and the denial of the MELANIA/ENRON/TRUST amendment all match fresh coverage (The Defiant, crypto.news, Bitcoin.com). Judge Marcelo Martinez de Giorgi dismissed Javier and Karina Milei and others on 2026-10-23, at the prosecutor's request (Perfil, Criptonoticias). The ~$94M December 2025 USDC drain comes from on-chain trackers (AMBCrypto, CoinGape), and the team has not confirmed intent, which is consistent with the write-up's framing.
